change.renderer_api: submit_captured_vulkan_frame accepts an optional caller-owned VkPipelineCache
change.plugin_lifetime: one cache per Vulkan device; destroyed after the guest GPU worker stops and before provider release
change.goal: reuse Vulkan driver's pipeline compilation cache across repeated retail frame submissions
remaining_per_frame_costs: draw buffers, images, descriptors, shader modules, and pipelines are still recreated per frame
FrameResources still waits for vkQueueWaitIdle before releasing those resources

native_host.cache_regression: same captured-data test frame submitted twice through one cache; full readbacks matched byte-for-byte

verification.android_arm64_renderer: xbox_live_vulkan_renderer_check target cross-compiled successfully; not executed on device

device_performance.reason: the cache-enabled plugin was not installed into the running Redmi package, and the phone game was left running
device_performance.previous_measured_rate: about 0.95 Vulkan submissions per second on Redmi Note 8 Pro
device_performance.claim: no speedup or retail cutscene completion is claimed

limitations: The renderer cache regression uses a synthetic offscreen fixture and does not prove retail parity.
The Vulkan pipeline cache is an in-memory driver cache; no disk serialization is implemented.
Per-frame allocations and queue-idle waits remain likely costs and need persistent resources plus explicit in-flight synchronization to remove.
